summary: Halo is a Kubernetes-operator-style Java CMS/blog platform: content (Post, SinglePage, Snapshot versioned content), taxonomy (Category, Tag), Comment/Reply community, User/Role/RoleBinding RBAC with PAT/device/remember-me auth, Attachment/Group/Policy storage, Menu/MenuItem, Theme/Plugin, Notification/Subscription off of Reason/ReasonType, and Backup, all persisted as extensions in a single SQL `extensions` table keyed by metadata.name.
